name: Central Carolina Community Foundation Lynches River Conservation grant
summary: Rolling grants for land conservation, land acquisition and water-quality projects that protect the Lynches River watershed in South Carolina. Amount varies with funding and project scope.

eligibility.rule: Be a 501(c)(3) nonprofit located in or serving South Carolina
Be organized under United States or state law
Directly benefit the Lynches River watershed in South Carolina
The project is not for fundraising, debt reduction, endowment development, capital campaigns or medical research

documents: 501(c)(3) tax exemption letter or fiscal sponsorship agreement, if requested
South Carolina charitable registration letter or exemption letter, if requested
Vision, values and mission statement, if requested
Board of Directors roster, if requested

status.quote: Applications are accepted year-round on a rolling basis.

applicant_types.quote: organizations must be a 501(c)(3) nonprofit located in or serving South Carolina

geography.quote: Projects must directly benefit the Lynches River watershed in South Carolina.

access.quote: Applications for Lynches River Conservation grants are accepted year-round through our online grant portal.
